title: Current Craftland editor source capture checklist
purpose: Enumerate authoritative editor-local inputs needed to resolve current PC APIs and Mobile visual block dropdowns that public mirrors cannot settle.

sources.artifact: Zip of current .fcc text library files, including version/build information
answers: current enum definitions and option values

sources.source: MCP Server URL available from within the Studio 1.19.0 editor per official patch notes
sources.artifact: Structured JSON/text responses for Blocks, Scripts, Scenes, UI, Animation Controllers and relevant node/port/options data
sources.security: Do not expose localhost endpoint or tokens publicly; export responses instead.

sources.artifact: Text copy of generated library from project, with private values removed if needed
answers: custom graph script names and import paths
sources.scope: Project-specific only; do not merge project-specific assets into a general official inventory without tagging.

sources.artifact: Block screenshot and full expanded dropdown screenshots, including scrolled sections, with script context/version

rules: Never infer Mobile visual block parity from PC .fcc declarations.
Keep current/obsolete/legacy and project-specific values separate.
Every row must record a source URL/blob/hash or screenshot filename, editor version and evidence status.
Do not mark compiled/playtested without actual test output.
